DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().notice: Recomputes on chain forks; stable otherwise.

VOUCHER_V2_TYPEHASH().notice: keccak256("VoucherV2(uint256 bountyId,uint8 slotIndex,address recipient,address token,uint256 amount,uint256 nonce,uint256 expiry,uint256 chainId,address escrow,bytes32 criteriaHash)") Pinned by `test_typehash_matches_frozen_string` and cross-checked against testdata/v3/eip712-voucher2.json.

claim((uint256,uint8,address,address,uin.notice: Settles one slot against a VoucherV2 authorization. Every bound field is re-checked; effects precede the transfer.

createBounty(uint256,address,uint256[],u.notice: Declare an immutable reward schedule. The caller becomes the sponsor. Amounts/deadline/criteriaHash SHOULD match the NEAR criteria document (UIs cross-check mechanically); a mismatch only bricks this sponsor's own bounty — claims fail closed.

fundBounty(uint256).notice: Pulls exactly `totalFunded` from the sponsor (approve first). Under/over-funding is impossible: the amount is the stored total.

proposeOwnership(address).notice: Two-step ownership (V2 used one step): propose, then the successor accepts. Re-proposing overwrites a mistaken proposal.

refundSlot(uint256,uint8).notice: Sponsor reclaims one unclaimed slot after the deadline. The claim/refund race resolves atomically on the bitmaps: exactly one of claim/refund can win per slot. Deadline-0 bounties are never refundable (funds remain claimable forever).

slotStatus(uint256,uint8).notice: Claim/refund flags for one slot (UIs + relayer pre-checks).
